title: K-flat-normalized derived coherent pullback tensor comparison
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and schemes in a universe $u$ [def-pc-scheme]. For a scheme $W$, use its small pro-etale ringed sequence site $\mathbf N\times W_{\mathrm{proet}}$, whose index $n\geq0$ means $B_{W,n}=(\mathcal O_E/\varpi^{n+1})_W$, with actual quotient ring maps; put $A_W=\lim_nB_{W,n}$ and let $\mathscr S_W$ be its category of module sheaves, equivalently strict quotient-semilinear systems [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site]. Write $e_{W,n}$ for exact evaluation, $\operatorname{Res}_{W,n}$ for restriction along $A_W\to B_{W,n}$ and $U_W:\mathscr S_W\to\operatorname{Tow}(\operatorname{Mod}(A_W))$ for their simultaneous exact scalar restriction. Use ordinary unbounded integer-indexed cochain and derived categories, with localization $q_W$ for $A_W$-modules, $q^s_W$ for sequence modules and $q^t_W$ for towers [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Use the fixed derived adjunction $\mathcal R_W\dashv\mathcal L_W$, with $\mathcal L_W=R\lim\circ D(U_W)$, and the specified derived tensor and cochain tensor models on the sequence site [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. A good integral complex is K-flat with flat terms; K-flat means that its direct-sum total tensor with every acyclic module complex is acyclic [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. All comparisons below use the actual chosen adjunctions, not arbitrary isomorphisms between their objects. No boundedness, constructibility, completeness of inputs, or invertibility of $\ell$ on the schemes is assumed. For a scheme morphism $f:X\to Y$, let $b_f$ on sequence sites be $(n,V)\mapsto(n,X\times_Y V)$. Its ring map is the actual constant-section coefficient map at every $n$; let $f^s_*:\mathscr S_X\to\mathscr S_Y$ be its module direct image, $F_f:\mathscr S_Y\to\mathscr S_X$ its specified left adjoint, $\eta^f$ the unit, and $D_f=D(F_f)$ the exact induced derived inverse image [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems]. Finite module pullback $f_n^*$ is equipped with its actual adjunction unit. The direct-image/evaluation comparison is identity on sections; the fixed inverse-image/evaluation isomorphism $v_{f,n}:f_n^* e_{Y,n}\xrightarrow{\sim}e_{X,n}F_f$ is its inverse mate under the specified finite and sequence adjunctions. Let $z_f$ be the pure-tensor-unit-normalized cochain comparison [lem-pur-sequence-pullback-tensor-cochain], and use K-flat preservation [lem-pur-sequence-pullback-kflat]. For K-flat $P,Q$ put $\tau_W(P,Q):q_W^s\operatorname{Tot}_W(P,Q)\xrightarrow{\sim}q_W^sP\otimes_W^Lq_W^sQ$, exactly the coherent calculus tensor model. Write $\delta_P:D_f(q_Y^sP)\xrightarrow{\sim}q_X^s(F_f^cP)$ for the fixed exact-derived factorization. There exists a unique natural isomorphism
$$\zeta_f:D_f(-\otimes_Y^L-)\xrightarrow{\sim}D_f(-)\otimes_X^LD_f(-)$$
satisfying, for every pair of K-flat sequence complexes $P,Q$,
$$(\delta_P\otimes_X^L\delta_Q)\circ\zeta_{f,(q_Y^sP,q_Y^sQ)}\circ D_f(\tau_Y(P,Q))
=\tau_X(F_f^cP,F_f^cQ)\circ q_X^s(z_{f,P,Q})\circ\delta_{\operatorname{Tot}_Y(P,Q)}.$$
Both sides go from $D_f(q_Y^s\operatorname{Tot}_Y(P,Q))$ to $q_X^s(F_f^cP)\otimes_X^Lq_X^s(F_f^cQ)$. This is pullbackTensorSystemComparison_existsUnique, as a map of whole coherent derived systems before applying any inverse limit; there is no termwise-flatness assumption on $P,Q$.

proof.text: Use the proved kFlatLocalization for the ringed sequence site: localization of all K-flat cochain complexes at quasi-isomorphisms gives the derived category. Its proof uses K-flat resolutions and includes complexes with arbitrary terms. Products of localization functors are localizations, so Mathlib Localization.fullyFaithfulWhiskeringLeft gives full faithfulness of precomposition with the product of K-flat localizations.

Apply tensorComparisonDescent with q=qprime=Q, F the termwise pullbackTensorSequenceInverse, LF=pullbackTensorSequenceDerived, and epsilon the hom of mapDerivedCategoryFactors. Take source and target representative classes to be all K-flat complexes; pullbackTensorSequenceGood gives preservation. The two representative tensor isomorphisms are exactly systemTensorModel.comparison of the two recorded calculi, and the chain isomorphism is pullbackTensorSequenceCochain. Exactness makes every component of epsilon invertible, including the component at the total tensor. All hypotheses of the categorical theorem are therefore met.

theorem pullbackTensorSystemComparison_existsUnique {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ∃! e : (pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).systemClosed.tensor ⋙
        pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f ≅
      ((pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f).prod (pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f)) ⋙
        (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).systemClosed.tensor,
      ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E Y) ℤ)
        (hP : @CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
          (ℕ × Y.ProEt) (inferInstance : Category.{u} (ℕ × Y.ProEt))
          (pullbackTensorSequenceSmall Y) (coefficientSequenceTopology (ProEt.topology Y))
          (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E Y) P)
        (hQ : @CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
          (ℕ × Y.ProEt) (inferInstance : Category.{u} (ℕ × Y.ProEt))
          (pullbackTensorSequenceSmall Y) (coefficientSequenceTopology (ProEt.topology Y))
          (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E Y) Q),
        (pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f).map
          (pullbackTensorSystemModel l E Y P Q hP hQ).hom ≫
          e.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) ≫
          (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).systemClosed.tensor.map
            (Prod.mkHom ((pullbackTensorSequenceInverse l E f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P)
              ((pullbackTensorSequenceInverse l E f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app Q)) =
        (pullbackTensorSequenceInverse l E f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app _ ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map ((pullbackTensorSequenceCochain l E f).hom.app (P,Q)) ≫
          (pullbackTensorSystemModel l E X _ _
            (pullbackTensorSequenceGood l E f P hP)
            (pullbackTensorSequenceGood l E f Q hQ)).hom
